summary.headline: Mars in Virgo and Libra
summary.text: Astrological predictions for Mars entering Virgo and Libra, including effects on weather, crops, food, disease, warfare, trade, rulers, professions, women, ships, and regional conditions in Egypt, the Levant, Hijaz, and Yemen. Authorities cited include Taj al-Din Akram, Hermes, Ptolemy, and al-Tusi.
